thread:
maya_sales: Hey team — enterprise prospect (OrionPay) is planning a migration from CompetitorX API. They want a POC next Tue. Main asks: prompt parity (stop token determinism), token billing parity, rate-limit/burst mapping, and security questionnaire. Who can own tech presales and parity checklist? cc @zach_se @nina_se

zach_se: I can take lead on the technical POC. Quick clarifying q: are they using a session header + streaming? Any special sync tokens?

maya_sales: Yes — they pass `session_id` header and an ordered `messages` array. They rely heavily on chunked streaming and expect exact stop-token behavior. Also use delta-based client logic (they assume identical chunk boundaries).

zach_se: Got it. Blocking items for parity smoke: 1) streaming envelope/frames, 2) stop-token determinism, 3) token counting differences across tokenizers. I'll run a parity harness against their sample prompts tomorrow.

nina_se: I'll own the security questionnaire (SQA). Maya: can you attach the customer's SQ PDF or Confluence link? Need to triage data residency, KMS, retention, and legal redlines.

maya_sales: Uploaded the SQ here: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ORION-POC/docs/orionpay-sq.pdf

ben_solutions: For the demo we can stand up a lightweight proxy shim to translate headers and normalize streaming events. Example config I usually share: 
```json
{
  "proxy":{
    "map_headers": {"x-client-session":"session_id"},
    "stream_mode": "chunked",
    "envelope": "single-event-per-line"
  }
}
```
I'll prepare a demo curl + Docker compose for Tues.

leo_research: Heads-up: model/tokenizer choice affects stop-token alignment. Recommend starting parity on `rwd-2-small` (same tokenization family) before moving to larger flavors. Quantization can introduce subtle differences in outputs, so call that out in the POC notes.

maya_sales: Pricing question from the buyer: they want a token-parity guarantee vs CompetitorX (i.e., equivalent billed tokens for same payload + response). How do we answer?

ada_pm: We don't provide a formal "token parity guarantee" (different tokenizers/formatting). Offer: include a billing reconciliation window during POC and run their sample corpus through both sides — we can provide a delta report and commit to a remediation plan if drift > X%. Suggest wording: "we'll run a billing parity analysis during POC and include reconciliation support for migration period."

zach_se: For contract language we can define an engineering SLO: "response-fidelity regression <= 1% on customer-provided evals" for initial migration month, with a documented remediation plan. Legal will want concrete evals/examples.

security_bot: SQ checklist (short): SOC2 status, HIPAA (if needed), KMS/HSM integration, E2E TLS, audit logs retention, RBAC, customer-controlled keys. Docs: https://security.redwood.ai/policies/sq-overview

nina_se: On retention: default POC retention = 30 days. We can support 0-day (no retention) for PII-sensitive customers if they sign a Limited Data Agreement and use Dedicated/Private deployment. I'll flag this in the SQ responses.

maya_sales: They also asked about rate limits — currently CompetitorX allows 10k rps burst for them. Can Redwood match?

zach_se: To match 10k rps with average 2-token responses we'd need ~8 high-throughput GPUs on Dedicated (rough estimate). Cost delta vs cloud-managed competitor likely 2-4x depending on model size and concurrency. I'll produce a formal estimate by EOD tomorrow.

ben_solutions: Demo curl for their engineers (compat endpoint):
```bash
curl -N -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/compat \\
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' \\
  -H 'x-client-session: 1234' \\
  -d '{"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Hello"}],"stream":true}'
```
Expect streaming lines like `event: chunk` with newline-delimited JSON per chunk. We'll show side-by-side CompetitorX output to highlight parity mapping.

maya_sales: Timeline: POC plan doc by EOD Friday, SQ answers by Thu, parity smoke + harness by Fri, demo run Tues. Owners: Zach (parity harness), Nina (SQ), Ben (proxy/demo). Can each confirm?

zach_se: Confirmed — parity harness + initial smoke results by Fri EOD.

nina_se: Confirmed — SQ answers by Thu noon, will include retention and KMS notes.

ben_solutions: Confirmed — proxy shim demo + curl scripts done and tested in sandbox.

deploybot: Sandbox cluster `orion-poc-sbx-17` provisioned (GPU nodes x4). IPs emailed to maya_sales.

maya_sales: Great — I'll update the customer and send calendar invites. Also they requested sample contract language and a short migration checklist. I'll draft and drop here. Thanks all :pray:

ada_pm: FYI — include an evaluation rubric: fidelity (intent-level), hallucination rate, latency delta, and token-billing delta. That's what Legal + Finance will look for.

maya_sales: Adding that to the POC doc now. If anything changes ping this thread.

zach_se: One more note — for stop-token determinism tests include edge cases: repeated delimiters, truncated context, and streaming reassembly. I'll add tests.

maya_sales: Perfect. Closing the loop — will post POC doc link when ready.
